'''Tycho Celchu's T-65 X-wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] flown during the [[Bacta War]] after the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] resigned his commission to the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] to help the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|I did some checking and, before Alderaan disarmed, that was the color scheme of the Alderaan Guard unit near my home used to sport.|Tycho Celchu explaing the significance of his X-wing's color scheme|<ref name="BW" />}}
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]]<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>, [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] helped procure several [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wings]] for the renegade members of Rogue Squadron --now going by "[[Antilles's Rogues]]"-- to aid them in their private guerrilla war against [[Ysanne Isard|Ysanne Isard's]] Imperial occupation of Thyferra. Tycho encouraged the members of Antilles's Rogues personalise their X-wings so that they could better present as a group independent from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. For his own X-wing, Tycho had half of the starfigher painted [[Color/Legends|blood red]] and the other half painted white, with both halves divided by a diagonal black stripe; this design was a motif to the disbanded military of Tycho's homeworld, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. To further add to this motif, Tycho cloned the [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]] of the [[Alderaanian War Frigate]], ''[[Another Chance]]'', and used it to replace his X-wing's standard transponder frequency.

This latter modification proved unexpectedly fortuitous when the Antilles's Rogues were caught in [[Second ambush in the Graveyard|an ambush]] in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan System]] by [[Captain/Legends|Imperial Captain]] [[Ait Convarion|Ait Convarion]] and his task force comprised of the [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory II-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Corrupter]]'', and the [[Interdictor-class cruiser]], ''[[Aggregator]]''. Tycho and the rest of the Antilles's Rogues would likely have perished were it not for the transponder of Tycho's X-wing accidentally activating the dormant automated [[light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]], ''[[Valiant]]'', which had been programmed to escort and protect ''Another Chance''. Believing Tycho's X-wing to be the ''Another Chance'', the ''Valiant'' helped Tycho attack the ''Corruptor'' and foil Captain Convarion's ambush. 

Tycho later piloted his X-wing in the final conflict of the Bacta War, the tumultuous [[Battle of Thyferra]], wherein he flew alongside his squadmate [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] in pursuit of a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]] believed to be piloted by an escaping Ysanne Isard. With an assist from Corran's targeting computer, Tycho's X-wing was able to fire a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] at the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], destroying it.<ref name="BW" /> In the aftermath of the victorious Battle of Thyferra, Tycho flew his X-wing with the rest of Rogue Squadron over the cityscape of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the entertainment of the New Republic citizenry celebrating the end of the Bacta War.<ref name="WS" />
